title: 第151章 明浒长老和心无痕长老第150章 影响牧龙天的应对
slug: 开局被退婚反手娶小姨子
lines: 天心宗。
明浒长老脸色难看，放下了手里的玉简，上面记载了炼尸门被覆灭的消息，就在不久前，炼尸门被彻底覆灭，他们安插在沧州内部的棋子没了，被连根拔起，一个弟子都没能跑出来。
真传弟子以及一些高层全部被杀，剩下的那些寻常弟子跑出来也没用，那些弟子，得不到重用，无法修炼炼尸门的核心功法，也无法接触到真正的炼尸门神通，那些弟子哪怕让他们修炼几百年，也不见得可以取得很高的成就。
不成真传，就无法得到真正的传承，也就没有了晋升劫境的希望，这是一个关卡，冲不过去的话，可就唯有失败，劫境才是强者，不入劫境，终究是不入流。
之前，或许明浒长老不这么认为，现如今，他知道实力才是根本，才是最为重要的。
“炼尸门覆灭了，心无痕师兄。”
他身边站着一个男人，男人站在这里，好像什么都不在乎的模样，那副姿态，神游天外。
好一会儿，他都没有动静，静静观望着远方的景色，没有被影响到，明浒长老很清楚，这位师兄又开始了，每一次都会这样子，他都习惯了，继续开始说他的话。
“炼尸门被连根拔起，所有高层全部被杀，一个都没能跑出来，九大尸将，陨落在炼尸门，白中生这个废物，当真是没用，抵抗几个月都做不到，这就被覆灭了。”
“我们投资了这么多，为的就是让炼尸门崛起，然后动乱沧州，谁能想到还没开始真正动手，天都门率先动手，打了我们一个措手不及，天都龙王还联合了莽山妖宫和积尘宗一起动手。”
“天剑门这边，估计也被他通过气，不然，天剑门为何会阻拦我们，不允许我们前进一步。”
“师兄，接下来，我们要如何做？那个小子肯定是跑去了沧州，躲在了沧州的莽山山脉之中，不知道他做了什么，得到了莽山妖宫的庇护，我们想要对他动手，恐怕没那么容易。”
心无痕长老回过神来，目光锁定在明浒长老身上，问：“你确定是他？”
明浒长老内心一紧，咬牙道：“师兄，师弟虽然不敢百分百确认，但是，师弟可以确认一点，那就是那个小子绝对来了沧州，莽山山脉之中，师弟感应到了那股气息，杀戮我们天心宗弟子的人才会拥有的气息，不会错的。”
“我们在那个世界所创立的天心宗就是被他所覆灭，天心小子在他身上留下了印记，那一道灵魂印记不会错的。”
“师兄，我们不能让那个小子继续成长，那个小子很……妖孽，再给他十年时间，我们到时候想要对付他，可就晚了。”
“趁现在他还没彻底崛起，我们还有机会，那个世界是我们的，牧龙家族那边奈何不了他，估计要放弃了，牧龙天那个老不死想要和我们联手一起对付他，然后共同分享那个世界。”
“其他的势力，估计会逐步放弃，投入和付出不成正比，他们自然不会继续执着于那个世界，我们不行，那个世界不能丢，否则，我们两个在宗门的话语权会丢失，而且，我们也无法得到补充。”
“那个世界虽说不怎么样，但是，他们是真的很有天赋，经历过了无数战斗走出来的人，都不简单。”
这些年，他们没有招收几个天心宗上来的人，但是呢，也不是没有招收，凡是招收的人，都是佼佼者，一开始不显眼，后来，逐步成为了宗门的强者。
他们之前也是一样，那个世界很弱小，但是，不简单。
就这么放弃，不值得。
“明浒师弟，你有把握对付他吗？”心无痕长老开口，脸色凝重。
“根据我所知道，沧州那边很危险，我们想要靠近莽山山脉可不容易，莽山妖宫不同以往，实力大增，足足有三尊劫境强者，我们两个人能否直面他们？”
“明浒师弟你的实力太弱了，无法直面劫境，单单是那些妖王，足以让你头痛。”
“劫境妖王，可不好对付，即便是我，也害怕遇到他们。”
心无痕长老很清楚，他的实力不能够应对……劫境强者，除非，他可以踏出那一步。
可是，那一步哪有那么容易踏出去，这么多年，他不也是在原定踏步。
“师兄，此事必须要加快，不然，给那个小子足够的时间修炼，他可能会迅速崛起，以那个小子的天赋，在那个世界都能迅速崛起，来到了沧州，修炼条件好了很多倍，他肯定会……突飞猛进。”
“而且，我们不知道他什么时候来沧州的，时间不确定，也不知道他修炼了多少年，获取了多少资源，莽山山脉内部什么都不多，就是各种灵药多，而那个小子还是个炼丹师。”
“他很可能和莽山妖宫的那些妖兽达成了什么约定，才有了莽山妖宫实力大增。”
“莽山妖宫阻拦我等，他们实力越强，对我们而言，威胁越大，以后，想要踏足沧州，不太可能。”
明浒长老十分清楚这一点，他们天心宗想要进入沧州，想要更多的地盘和资源，想要崛起，资源是必不可少的。
目前而言，他们所掌控的地盘和资源达到了极限，无法继续提升，宗门想要更进一步，必须要开拓，灵州内外都被分割完成了，不可能有多余的地盘给他们，稍微一点资源，都被标记了。
沧州，最弱，也是最适合动手的，危险系数最低。
宗门暂时没能下定决心，不敢贸然行动。
“万妖殿的六目妖王和牧龙家族都想要沧州，他们都想要针对莽山妖宫动手，我们或许可以和他们联手，一起覆灭莽山妖宫。”
失去了莽山妖宫的阻拦，他们可以在莽山山脉内开辟出一条路，安全的路，直通沧州，那样的话，他们就可以……畅行无阻，再也没有阻碍。
沧州，迟早是他们的囊中之物。
只是，目前出现了意外。
出现了一个让他们更加值得对付的人，那个小子，不仅仅是他们，牧龙家族那边，也想要杀了他，而且，比起他们更加想要杀了他。

content_en:
Tianxin Sect.
Elder Minghu looked ugly and put down the jade slip in his hand, which recorded the news of the destruction of the Corpse Refining Sect. Not long ago, the Corpse Refining Sect was completely destroyed. The chess pieces they had placed inside Cangzhou were gone and uprooted. Not a single disciple could escape.
The true disciples and some high-level officials were all killed, and it was useless for the remaining ordinary disciples to run out. Those disciples could not be reused, could not practice the core skills of the Corpse Refining Sect, and could not come into contact with the true supernatural powers of the Corpse Refining Sect. Even if those disciples were allowed to practice for hundreds of years, they might not be able to achieve high achievements.
If you don't achieve true inheritance, you won't be able to get a real inheritance, and there will be no hope of advancing to the Tribulation Realm. This is a level. If you can't pass it, you will only fail. The Tribulation Realm is the strong one. If you don't enter the Tribulation Realm, you will ultimately be inferior.
Before, Elder Minghu might not have thought so, but now, he knows that strength is the foundation and the most important thing.
"The Corpse Refining Sect has been destroyed, Senior Brother Xin Wuhen."
There was a man standing next to him. The man stood here as if he didn't care about anything. His attitude was as if he was in a state of confusion.
For a while, he did not move, quietly watching the distant scenery without being affected. Elder Minghu knew very well that this senior brother had started again. It would be like this every time. He was used to it and continued to speak.
"The Corpse Refining Sect was uprooted, all the high-level officials were killed, and not a single one could escape. The nine corpse generals fell in the Corpse Refining Sect. Bai Zhongsheng, this waste, was really useless. He couldn't resist for several months, so he was destroyed."
"We invested so much in order to let the Corpse Refining Sect rise and cause chaos in Cangzhou. Who would have thought that before we even started to really take action, the Tiandu Sect took the lead and caught us off guard. The Tiandu Dragon King also joined forces with the Mangshan Demon Palace and the Jichen Sect to take action."
"The Heavenly Sword Sect is probably also influenced by him. Otherwise, why would the Heavenly Sword Sect stop us and not allow us to take a step forward."
"Senior brother, what should we do next? That kid must have gone to Cangzhou and hid in the Mangshan Mountains in Cangzhou. I don't know what he did and was protected by the Mangshan Demon Palace. If we want to do something to him, it may not be that easy."
Elder Xin Wuhen came back to his senses, locked his eyes on Elder Minghu, and asked, "Are you sure it's him?"
Elder Minghu's heart tightened, and he gritted his teeth and said: "Senior Brother, although Junior Brother cannot be 100% sure, Junior Brother can confirm one thing, that is, that boy has definitely come to Cangzhou. In the Mangshan Mountains, Junior Brother can sense that aura. It is the aura that only those who kill our Tianxin Sect disciples can have. It is unmistakable."
"The Tianxin Sect we founded in that world was destroyed by him. The Tianxin boy left a mark on him. That soul mark is unmistakable."
"Senior brother, we can't let that kid continue to grow. That kid is very... evil. If we give him another ten years, it will be too late if we want to deal with him by then."
"We still have a chance before he has fully risen. That world belongs to us. The Mu Long family can't do anything to him, so they probably have to give up. The old immortal Mu Longtian wants to join forces with us to deal with him, and then share that world together."
"Other forces are expected to gradually give up. Their investment and contribution are not proportional. Naturally, they will not continue to be attached to that world. We cannot, and that world cannot be lost. Otherwise, the two of us will lose our right to speak in the sect, and we will not be able to be replenished."
"Although that world is not very good, they are really talented. People who have gone through countless battles and come out are not simple."
Over the years, they have not recruited many people from the Tianxin Sect, but it is not that they have not recruited anyone. All the people they recruit are outstanding. They were inconspicuous at the beginning, but later gradually became the strong ones of the sect.
It was the same for them before. That world was very weak, but not simple.
It's not worth giving up like that.
"Junior Brother Minghu, are you sure you can deal with him?" Elder Xin Wuhen said, his face solemn.
"According to what I know, Cangzhou is very dangerous. It's not easy for us to get close to the Mangshan Mountains. The Mangshan Demon Palace is different from the past. Its strength has greatly increased. There are three strong men in the Tribulation Realm. Can the two of us face them head-on?"
"Junior Brother Minghu, you are too weak to face the calamity directly. Those demon kings alone are enough to give you a headache."
"The demon kings of the Tribulation Realm are not easy to deal with. Even I am afraid of meeting them."
Elder Xin Wuhen knew very well that his strength could not cope with... the powerful ones in the Tribulation Realm, unless he could take that step.
However, that step is never so easy to take. For so many years, he has been taking the original step.
"Senior brother, this matter must be accelerated. Otherwise, if you give that boy enough time to practice, he may rise quickly. With that boy's talent, he can rise quickly in that world. When he comes to Cangzhou, the training conditions are many times better, and he will definitely... advance by leaps and bounds."
"Furthermore, we don't know when he came to Cangzhou. The time is uncertain, and we don't know how many years he has been practicing and how many resources he has obtained. There is not much in the Mangshan Mountains, but there are many kinds of elixirs, and that kid is still an alchemist."
"He probably made some agreement with the monsters in the Mangshan Demon Palace, which is why the strength of the Mangshan Demon Palace has greatly increased."
"The Mangshan Demon Palace is blocking us. The stronger they are, the greater the threat to us. It is unlikely that we will set foot in Cangzhou in the future."
Elder Minghu knew this very well. Their Tianxin Sect wanted to enter Cangzhou and wanted more territory and resources. If they wanted to rise, resources were indispensable.
At present, the territory and resources they control have reached the limit and cannot continue to improve. If the sect wants to go further, it must open up. The division inside and outside Lingzhou has been completed. There is no extra territory for them. The slightest resource has been marked.
Cangzhou is the weakest and most suitable for taking action, with the lowest risk factor.
The sect could not make up its mind for the time being and did not dare to act rashly.
"The Six-Eyed Demon King of the Ten Thousand Demon Palace and the Mulong Family both want Cangzhou, and they all want to target the Mangshan Demon Palace. Perhaps we can join forces with them to destroy the Mangshan Demon Palace."
Without the obstruction of the Mangshan Demon Palace, they can carve out a safe road in the Mangshan Mountains, leading directly to Cangzhou. In that case, they can... travel unimpeded, without any hindrance.
Cangzhou will be theirs sooner or later.
However, something unexpected happened now.
Someone appeared who made them more worthy of dealing with that boy. Not only them, but also the Mulong family wanted to kill him, and they wanted to kill him even more than they did.
